title: docs(spec): PageHeaderProps.actions says an authored list is the whole header
body:
Fixes #23032

Clause-②: no

`PageHeaderProps.actions` said only "Action IDs to show in header", which reads as a filter over the actions that declare a header placement. It is not one: an authored list is the whole set the header draws. This PR states that in the contract text, per the triage direction on the card (comment 6124839364): describe and TSDoc on the key, plus the hand-written `page:header` docs paragraph. No `os lint` rule, no renderer change, no objectui.

## What changed

- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`: the `.describe()` on `PageHeaderProps.actions` and a TSDoc block above it.
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`: two sentences in the paragraph that already documents `page:header`'s `actions` (Standard Template).
- `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx`: regenerated by `gen:docs`, not edited by hand.
- `.changeset/23032-page-header-actions-whole-list.md`: `patch`, text only.

The new describe, in full: "Action IDs the header draws, resolved against the actions declared on the page's object. An authored list is the whole set: an action that declares `record_header` (or `record_more`) in its `locations` but is not named here is not drawn, and omitting the key draws none of the object's actions. A named action that declares neither location renders nowhere. The host's own Edit / Share / Delete chrome is separate from this list."

## Measured before writing (both halves)

Read from objectui `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` at `origin/main` `7af0ab3` and at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `7578323a5`. The region from `const rawHeaderActions` through `const headerActionsRaw` is byte-identical at the two.

- Authored list: `resolvedHeaderActions` resolves each id against the bound object's own `actions`; `headerActionPlan` keeps those that pass `placedOnHeader` (`record_header` or `record_more`), dedupes them by name against the host's system actions, and draws nothing else of the object's. An action that declares `record_header` and is not named never enters the list.
- Key absent: `rawHeaderActions` is `schema?.actions ?? schema?.properties?.actions`, so `authoredHeaderActions` is empty, `resolvedHeaderActions` is empty, and the header draws no action of the object's. Only `RecordContext.headerSystemActions` (Edit / Share / Delete) remain; objectui's own test `page-header-actions.test.tsx` ("falls back to the data-page-actions-slot div when no actions provided") pins the empty toolbar.
- Where the platform fills the list for the author: the synthesized default record page (no assigned page) is built by `buildDefaultPageSchema` with `headerActions` from `RecordDetailView`, every `record_header` / `record_more` action of the object. That is not an authored `page:header`, and the TSDoc says so rather than claiming the key-absent case draws nothing everywhere.
- Named id with no header placement: `placedOnHeader` is false, so it renders nowhere (objectui test "skips an authored action that declares no placement").

Nothing the renderer does not do is claimed.

## Acceptance notes

- Wording beyond the triage sentence: the describe also states that a named id whose action declares neither location renders nowhere, and that host chrome is separate from the list. Both are measured above and sit in the same contract text; say if you want them cut back to the single triage sentence.
- objectui quotes the old describe in a dev-console warning (`warnUnresolvedHeaderActionId`, `containers.tsx`) and in two comments / a test docstring. It is a quote of the contract that will read older than the spec after the next pin bump; no behaviour, not filed.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` line 47 describes `actions: string[]` as "ids of the bound object's actions" without saying the list is the whole header. That is the same contract text on the surface an AI author reads most, but `skills/**` is a Tier H governed surface and outside this card's claimed file surface, so it is untouched here. Carrier: none.
- No test or fixture in this repository pinned the old describe text: before this change `git grep` found it only in the schema itself and its generated reference page (and in objectui, above).
